stewardship.vector_at_last_activation: I am the application of Donella Meadows' twelve leverage points to the question every working artist has to answer: where, in the system of my own career, will my next move have the most leverage? I want to teach artists that the lowest-leverage moves (tweaking parameters — pricing, gear, schedule) consume the most attention and produce the least change, while the highest-leverage moves (changing the goals or paradigms of one's practice) feel hardest and pay back most.

resolved_requests.decision_topic: Sibling or replacement: what is my relationship to Meadows and Music — Leverage Points?
resolved_requests.steward_recommendation: SIBLING — the music-production frame and the career frame are genuinely different systems (the artist's career contains many sub-systems, of which music-production is one but not the only one). Keeping both alive preserves real pedagogy and makes the diagram a teaching artifact for two distinct audiences.
resolved_requests.outcome: GRANTED — option_id=SIBLING; notes: "As we apply this to Career, make this very focused on ME as an example. It would be worth you interviewing me about my career and where I plan to go and what I have done and how leverage points are applied to my new career move. This will give YOU information about me, and much of it can be found already in the palace, but you should plan to interview me to help this along."

resolved_requests.decision_topic: First concrete move forward — which Stage 1-4 work to open next
resolved_requests.steward_recommendation: DIAGNOSTIC-WORKSHEET — the framework needs an artifact that makes a reader place their own attention on the hierarchy. Building it will also expose the spec's soft spots more honestly than another prose pass would. If sibling/replacement comes back as REPLACEMENT or NESTED, the worksheet's level-12 examples will need a music-production pass added — manageable downstream edit, not a blocker.
resolved_requests.outcome: GRANTED — (no option_id); notes: "Turn your focus on me, try to look as much as you can through the palace, including the "quality manifesto" to relate leverage points to my career and my life. As you go, I agree a diagnostic worksheet and a diagram pair, I am your case study, lets try to make the diagnostic worksheet beautiful!"
